targets.query:
from(bucket: 'processo')
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == 'prometheus' and r._field == 'edge_up')
  |> filter(fn: (r) => (r.ip == '${ip}' or '${ip}' == ''))
  |> last()

from(bucket: 'processo')
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == 'prometheus' and r._field == 'edge_up')
  |> filter(fn: (r) => (r.ip == '${ip}' or '${ip}' == ''))
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _value: float(v: now() - r._time) / 1000000000.0 }))

from(bucket: 'processo')
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == 'prometheus' and r._field == 'edge_up')
  |> filter(fn: (r) => (r.ip == '${ip}' or '${ip}' == ''))
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _value: (uint(v: now()) - uint(v: r._time)) > 60000000000 }))

from(bucket: 'processo')
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == 's7_db1' and r._field == 'contador_bom')
  |> filter(fn: (r) => (r.ip == '${ip}' or '${ip}' == '') and (r.db == '${db}' or '${db}' == ''))
  |> derivative(unit: 1m, nonNegative: true)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> last()

from(bucket: 'processo')
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == 's7_db1' and r._field == 'contador_ruim')
  |> filter(fn: (r) => (r.ip == '${ip}' or '${ip}' == '') and (r.db == '${db}' or '${db}' == ''))
  |> derivative(unit: 1m, nonNegative: true)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> last()

import 'math'
prod = from(bucket: 'processo')
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == 's7_db1' and (r._field == 'contador_bom' or r._field == 'contador_ruim'))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => (r.ip == '${ip}' or '${ip}' == '') and (r.db == '${db}' or '${db}' == ''))
  |> pivot(rowKey:['_time'], columnKey: ['_field'], valueColumn: '_value')
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, qualidade: if exists r.contador_bom and exists r.contador_ruim and (r.contador_bom + r.contador_ruim) > 0 then float(v: r.contador_bom) / float(v: r.contador_bom + r.contador_ruim) * 100.0 else 0.0 }))
  |> last()
prod
